name: Lumenwave Analytics
tagline: Self-serve analytics for teams that live in their data
about: Lumenwave Analytics builds a self-serve analytics platform that lets operations, finance and product teams explore their own data without waiting on a queue of dashboard requests. More than 2,000 companies use Lumenwave to model metrics once and share them everywhere.

name: Ironvale Robotics
tagline: Autonomous mobile robots for the modern warehouse
about: Ironvale Robotics designs, builds and operates fleets of autonomous mobile robots that move goods through distribution centers. Our robots, fleet software and on-site teams help warehouses ship faster with fewer injuries.

name: Fernhollow Health
tagline: Software that gives clinicians their time back
about: Fernhollow Health makes scheduling, charting and patient messaging software for independent clinics and regional health systems. Our products support more than 40,000 clinicians and the patients who rely on them.

name: Quillstone Financial
tagline: Payments and treasury infrastructure for growing businesses
about: Quillstone Financial gives finance teams one place to move money: card issuing, bill pay, payouts and treasury, built on our own payments infrastructure. We process billions of dollars a year for more than 15,000 businesses.

name: Cobaltway Logistics
tagline: The operating system for regional freight
about: Cobaltway Logistics connects shippers, carriers and warehouses on one freight platform. Our software plans loads, prices lanes and tracks every shipment in real time across North America.

name: Maplestep Learning
tagline: Adaptive math and reading practice for K-12 classrooms
about: Maplestep Learning builds adaptive practice and assessment tools used by teachers in more than 6,000 schools. We pair learning science with careful engineering to help every student make a year of progress in a year.

name: Orchard & Pine Goods
tagline: Home goods, made to last, delivered to your door
about: Orchard & Pine Goods is a direct-to-consumer home goods retailer with an online store, a marketplace of independent makers and 40 showrooms. Our technology teams run everything from the storefront to the fulfillment network.

name: Vectorline Security
tagline: Threat detection and response for critical infrastructure
about: Vectorline Security protects utilities, manufacturers and public agencies with a detection and response platform built for operational technology networks. Our analysts and engineers work alongside customers around the clock.

name: Sunmere Grid
tagline: Forecasting and control software for a renewable grid
about: Sunmere Grid builds forecasting, dispatch and battery control software for utilities and independent power producers. Our platform helps operators keep the grid balanced as wind and solar take over.

name: Cindral Cloud
tagline: The commerce cloud for B2B sellers
about: Cindral Cloud gives B2B manufacturers and distributors a complete commerce platform: catalogs, pricing, quoting, ordering and payments. Thousands of brands run their wholesale business on Cindral.

name: Driftlight Games
tagline: Cozy multiplayer worlds for players of every age
about: Driftlight Games is an independent studio making cozy online games for PC, console and mobile. Our first title has welcomed more than eight million players, and we are building what comes next.

name: Gullwing Mutual
tagline: Insurance that has looked after families since 1972
about: Gullwing Mutual is a member-owned insurer offering home, auto and life coverage across 30 states. Our digital teams are rebuilding claims, policy and member experiences on a modern cloud stack.

name: Sableleaf AI
tagline: AI agents that do the paperwork of logistics
about: Sableleaf AI builds AI agents that read, check and file the documents behind every shipment: bills of lading, customs forms and invoices. We are a small, senior team backed by early-stage investors.

name: Lanternway Civic Systems
tagline: Digital services for state and local government
about: Lanternway Civic Systems builds and runs digital services for state and local agencies: benefits applications, permitting and public records. We work in the open and measure success by the residents we serve.

name: Wrenfield Partners
tagline: Technology and strategy consulting for complex organizations
about: Wrenfield Partners is a global consultancy helping banks, retailers and public bodies modernize their technology and operations. Our teams combine strategy, engineering and data practitioners on every engagement.
